B3_B5: Motivating known approximately9pp gaps are not tuning targets; exact historical rates need not be hit. Panels cannot select family/config or substitute for chronological OOF evidence.
CLEAR_SUCCESS: Convincing joint conditional and composed loss improvement, chronologically persistent across nine years with both paired uncertainty intervals favorable, supporting Brier/calibration/pathway evidence and no major damage to preservation panel or complete-system classwise calibration. Quantify strongest-year dependence and every contrary result. Aggregate loss alone insufficient.
CURRENT_SPECIFICATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: Worse probability quality or failure to establish coherent incremental value under this specification; no rescue/grid expansion. Retain negative evidence.
INCONCLUSIVE: Small or unstable differences, intervals span no meaningful improvement, mixed annual evidence or material calibration/preservation tradeoffs. No new numeric cutoff derived from results; judge all preregistered dimensions explicitly.
major_degradation_review: Report preservation-cell change in absolute calibration gap and paired loss/Brier with yearly direction and sample status; assess size against Wilson/paired uncertainty and current MIN behavior. Qualitative judgement documented, not automatic cell-specific acceptance threshold. Thin cells cannot establish major damage alone.
shadow_policy: No project winner chosen by fixed-family outer scores; no additional library after outcomes.
